newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index still mixed,S&Ps hold small gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index still mixed,S&Ps hold small gains.

text.p: July 21 - U.S. stock index futures stayed mixed late, with S&P 500s still holding moderate gains. Traders said they waited for IBM Q2 earnings report due after Monday's close and Tuesday's start of Humphrey-Hawkins testimony. Sept S&P 500s backed off again after unsuccessfully retesting the morning's peak at 920.00 but lacked power to punch much below 914.00.
